menu.aciklama: Account = the email you sign in with (credits, subscription, AI history). You can switch between open accounts with one tap. To switch between veterinarians who share this device, use "Switch Veterinarian (this device)" (PIN).

menu.cikisGovdeTekrar: You will be signed out of {{eposta}}. You will need your email and password to sign in again.

operator.baskaHesapAciklama: To switch to another email account or add one, open "Email accounts".
operator.cokHataliKilitli: Too many failed attempts — this operator is temporarily locked. Wait a few minutes.

operator.kayitAciklama: You will be registered as {{email}}. If you share this device with other {{cogulIle}}, register: patient, session and AI records are saved under your name, the "My …" filters show you, and switching between {{cogul}} uses a PIN (offline). Once registered, the device switches to multi-user mode: actions that write records require a selected {{tekil}}, lists show no records until a {{tekil}} is selected, and the selection clears after {{dakika}} min of inactivity (not while a session is running).

operator.pasifListedenSec: Select a {{tekil}} from the list and enter the 6-digit PIN.
